warning: Public-safe class skill impact mapping. It joins player-facing job names/icons with static skill table operations. It is not a full DPS simulator.
assumptions: ValueLevelFactors reference SkillLevelFactorTable columns. They are scaling factor ids, not literal per-level stat amounts.
Stat operation values with ratio-like stat names are treated as fixed-point percent values where 150 means 15%.
Active buff uptime uses duration divided by cooldown when both are present. Passive and permanent operations use full uptime.
Attack percent buffs, conditional weakness, projectiles, summons, and rotation timing are exposed but scored conservatively by the UI.
